exercise.title: 3rds to 6ths, falling
exercise.why: In a falling leap the top note comes first with no Do under it, so your ear has to measure down, and minor is one half step away from major each time.

cells.text: Press Start below. The game plays a note and then one a 3rd, a 4th, a 5th or a 6th below it. Hum the lower note back, then pick its name: m3 or M3 for a minor or major 3rd, m6 or M6 for a minor or major 6th.
